newsitem.title: USA: Huntsman refuses to deal with mgmn't in Rexene bid.
newsitem.headline: Huntsman refuses to deal with mgmn't in Rexene bid.

text.p: Privately-held Huntsman Corp said Thursday it is still interested in acquiring Rexene Corp for $16 a share, although it has "no interest" in attempting to deal further with Rexene Corp's current management.
Rexene has already turned down three offers from Huntsman and mischaracterized the third offer as not "fully funded," it said.
Huntsman believed Rexene management was looking for a buyer for the company, but failed to find one who would pay more than $16 a share.
Officials from Rexene were unavailable for comment.
A Huntsman spokesman said a refusal to deal with management did not mean it would appeal directly to shareholders.

The spokesman also said it was in no way connected with a dissident group of shareholders led by Wyser-Pratte & Co that has said it would consider selling the company for cash and will press plans to enhance shareholder value at an April 30, special shareholders meeting.
